items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 23 at 2:13AM EDT until September 25 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Edisto Beach to Savannah out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
